meanings.en: to get in touch with, to contact
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'вязаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'will get in touch', paired with 'связываться'.
